PortalMetrics.title: PortalMetrics
PortalMetrics.description: Real-time global visitor and consultation metrics for the Akashic Ouija portal.

totalVisits.description: Cumulative count of real visits across all devices and sessions.

todayVisits.description: Count of real visits recorded for todayKey.

todayKey.description: Date key in YYYY-MM-DD format for daily visit tracking.

totalConsultations.description: Cumulative count of channeled Ouija and Akashic consultations.

uniqueVisitorsCount.description: Total count of unique anonymous visitor markers.

lastUpdated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the latest update.

UniqueVisitor.title: UniqueVisitor
UniqueVisitor.description: Anonymous visitor identifier marker containing no PII.

firstSeenAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the visitor was first recorded.

MonetizationConfig.title: MonetizationConfig
MonetizationConfig.description: Global monetization and consultation limit configuration (Mercado Pago only) controlled by the portal owner.

mpLink.description: Mercado Pago URL for consultation passes.

paywallEnabled.description: Whether the consultation paywall activates after the free limit is reached.

freeConsultationsLimit.description: Number of free past-life and spirit consultations allowed before requiring payment (typically 1 or 2).

passPriceArs.description: Display price in ARS for unlocking remaining consultations via Mercado Pago.

passAmountArs.description: Numeric ARS amount for the Mercado Pago pass.

autoReturnTokenHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the secret return token appended to automatic Mercado Pago post-payment redirect URLs.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest monetization update.

PaymentSession.title: PaymentSession
PaymentSession.description: Real-time Mercado Pago payment session state used for automatic consultation unlock across browser tabs.

provider.description: Payment provider used for this session (Mercado Pago).

pendingType.description: Type of consultation queued to run automatically upon unlock.

refCode.description: Short reference code for Mercado Pago session tracking.

approvalProof.description: Server HMAC-SHA256 verification digest present only when status is approved.

/metrics/{metricId}.description: Global metrics singleton document ('global') for real-time visitor and consultation counts.

/visitors/{visitorId}.description: Anonymous unique visitor markers used to track unique visitor counts.

/config/{configId}.description: Global singleton configuration document ('monetization') editable only by the verified owner.

/payment_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Ephemeral real-time payment session status documents keyed by unguessable session IDs.
